count_scope: One exact PubMed identity only; no corpus/citation-list/author-entity coverage is inferred.
retrieval_cache_note: The web retrieval service controls its own upstream cache; this is a new tool access, not proof of a new origin HTTP response.
timeout_note: Web retrieval tool exposes no caller timeout parameter; actual call timestamps retained.

source_locators.observation: Only the HHS disclosure footer was exposed; no matching bibliographic header was readable.

integration_guard: Match existing DOI/title/byline record and retain its work_id, work_key, Version and existing Person relationships. Work-scoped byline affiliation does not establish a cross-Work Person merge; do not infer ORCID or current affiliation.
error_message: The official PubMed retrieval exposed only a footer; DOI/PMID bridge and metadata remain unverified by this access.
license_note: Bibliographic facts and locators only. Original abstract, full text, figures, references payload, street addresses, email/contact addresses and credentials excluded.
raw_response_retention: Private local tool-response cache outside repository; not for Git publication.
